plugins.name: crbiz-pm
plugins.description: CRBiz PM for Claude Code. PM-as-Configuration-Overlay grammar with reference implementations of the discovery-strategy, tailwind-catalyst-app and zoho-catalyst-app archetypes. Install via marketplace on any surface; slash-command invocation runs in Claude Code CLI on a local folder or a Claude Code remote session against a repo (not currently supported in claude.ai/code Cowork). Bidirectional HTML board, chip-spawn wrapper with per-chip git worktree allocation, Tie-back protocol, lean PM context, and the change-management surface (/pm-cr, /pm-cab, /pm-lint I15). v2.5 of the PM-on-CC discipline applies the Opus 5.5 prompt audit and fixes a v2.4.0 defect in which every chip halted at its first turn: the spawn template pinned a retired model and its model gate refused any mismatch. The spawning PM now picks each chip's model with a one-line reason, the model IDs live in one reference file, and a chip stops only when it runs on a less capable model than proposed. The PM session takes routine next steps and reports them, confirming first only for merging to main, sending outside the team, deleting what git cannot recover, and production deploys; every authorisation gate is unchanged. Chips launch from the CLI in a Windows Terminal tab as well as from Desktop, and a PM session warns when jq is missing and the lane and staging guards are therefore inactive. 42 skills + 6 agents + SessionStart hook + 2 PreToolUse hooks (git-stage-guard + worktree-visibility-guard); /pm-lint runs 24 checks.

plugins.name: crbiz-skills
plugins.description: CRBiz's own Claude skills for Zoho consulting. An L0 foundation — platform mechanics (OAuth, data centres, API credits), the Deluge language, the product catalogue and persona-based licensing architecture — under six L1 product specialists: CRM on API v8 (Composite, Bulk, COQL, GraphQL, Notification), Desk, Analytics, Catalyst, Field Service Management, and the finance suite (Books, Invoice, Billing, Inventory, Expense, Payroll). Each specialist keeps judgement in SKILL.md, depth in references/, and carries a dated source note recording what was verified, against which documentation, and what could not be — so a stale fact is visible rather than inferred. Also ships BRD/PRD elicitation, WordPress and SEO migration, and finance and mail administration. Working conventions ship as a SessionStart hook so language and output format are right in the first reply rather than after a skill happens to trigger. Identity, agent-to-agent escalation, BAU and bug structure, and client-area layout are owned by the Global PM BRD and referenced, never restated. 0.2.1 applies the Opus 5.5 prompt audit: the product catalogue routes only to skills that exist and names the products not yet covered, the Kinsta skill uses MyKinsta, the Kinsta API and WP-CLI in place of an unpublished CLI, SEO guidance uses INP and GA4 key events, and the cfo and mail-admin bodies are tightened with their facts kept. 18 skills + 1 agent + SessionStart hook + a six-check validation harness.
